name: filesystem directory lifecycle
source: import { mkdirSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; function main(): void { const dir: string = '/tmp/thaw-node-dir-compat'; rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); mkdirSync(dir); writeFileSync(dir + '/b.txt', 'b'); writeFileSync(dir + '/a.txt', 'a'); console.log(readdirSync(dir).sort().join(',')); rmSync(dir, { recursive: true }); }
